senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חדר, חזר)to enclose, go around. Part. pass. הָדוּר

units: <cite ref="Chullin 59b">Ḥull. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>הֲדוּרוֹת בעינן</he> Ar. (ed. <he>חֲדוּרוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="H00212"><he>חָדַר</he></cite>) the horns must de rounded (not flat; Ar.: showing circular layers).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60:1">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="E00545"><he>הלזה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 24:25">Gen. XXIV, 25</cite>) <he>ראתה אותו ה׳</he> she saw his commanding appearance; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 90:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XC</cite>, end.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30:10">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>שהִדְּרוֹ הקב״ה וכ׳</he> whom the Lord crowned with old age.
Kidd. 32ᵇ יְהַדְּרֶנּוּ בממון that he must show him honor even at a material sacrifice; a. e.—Part. pass. מְהוּדָּר.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 3:2">Lev. R. s. 3</cite> <he>שיהא המזבח מה׳ וכ׳</he> that the altar may appear adorned by the poor man’s offering; a. e.

senses.gloss: to go around searching, whence to be zealous in religious observances, to look out for the best method of doing good.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 21b:5">Sabb. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>המְהַדְּרִין</he> the zealous, <he>המה׳ מן המה׳</he> the most zealous. V. <cite ref="E00345"><he>הִידּוּר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:3">Gen. R. s. 1</cite> <he>הוא לבדו מִתְהַדֵּר וכ׳</he> He alone is glorified through His world.
